calls.place.summary: Place a call, choosing the SIM

telephony.ussd.summary: Send carrier codes such as *100#, after you confirm each one

notifications.post.summary: Post notifications with channels, actions and replies

intents.open.summary: Open links and share to other apps

intents.start.summary: Ask another app to do something, through the chooser

usb.summary: USB host devices: open, claim, transfer

apps.list.summary: See installed apps and their icons (special, asks later)

usage.read.summary: See app usage times (special, one app at a time, asks later)

notifications.listen.summary: Read, dismiss, reply to and open other apps' notifications (special, one app at a time, asks later; needs Notification access)

accessibility.summary: Read other apps' screens and tap, type, scroll and swipe in them (special, one app at a time, asks later; needs the launcher's Accessibility switch)

clipboard.watch.summary: Watch the clipboard while open (special, asks later)

accounts.read.summary: See the other accounts on the phone that Android shows the launcher (special, asks later; foreground only)

location.background.summary: Location after the user leaves the app: a route watch inside fgs type location, and geofences that wake the app (special, asks later; also needs location)

nfc.hce.payment.summary: Answer payment terminals as a contactless card (payment-category AIDs) while the app is open and the phone unlocked; each command answered within 1.5 s, else 6F00; not verifiable without a payment terminal, and real payments need network-issued card credentials no sideloaded app can get (special, one app at a time, asks later; Android also asks to make the launcher the default payment app)

role.browser.summary: Be the phone's browser: tapped http/https links reach the app as data (special, one app at a time, asks later; Android also asks to make the launcher the default browser)

role.assistant.summary: Be the phone's assistant: holding Home or the assist gesture opens the app (special, one app at a time, asks later; the user also picks the launcher as digital assistant app)

device.admin.summary: Lock the screen now, also from background runs, through the launcher's lock-only device admin; never wipe (special, one app at a time, asks later; Android also asks to activate the device admin)

wallpaper.summary: Be the phone's live wallpaper: the manifest wallpaper page runs while the home or lock screen shows, gets touches and home-screen offsets, and gets needs_foreground for anything that opens a screen (special, one app at a time, asks later; Android also asks to set the wallpaper)

ime.summary: Be the phone's keyboard: the manifest keyboard page types into other apps (ime.* only from that page); never sees password fields or the text around the cursor; gets needs_foreground for anything that opens a screen (special, one app at a time, asks later; Android also asks to turn on and choose the keyboard)

calls.screen.summary: Screen incoming calls before they ring: allow, silence or reject each one within 4 seconds (else it rings), also from background runs; the number only with calllog.read or contacts.read; emergency calls never (special, one app at a time, asks later; if the launcher is not the phone app, Android also asks to make it the caller ID and spam app)

display.summary: Keep screen on, orientation, print, hide from screenshots

torch.summary: Camera flashlight while the app is open

sensors.summary: Motion and environment sensors while the app is open; daily step totals (stepsToday) any time

system.stats.summary: Memory, thermal, battery, storage and CPU frequency figures of this phone

keystore.summary: Keys that stay on this phone, optionally locked by fingerprint or face, while the app is open

audio.control.summary: Volumes, ringer mode and speaker or earpiece routing while the app is open

dnd.summary: Do Not Disturb on or off and whether it is on, while the app is open

media.read.summary: Photos, videos and audio files on this phone, while the app is open

speech.tts.summary: Read text aloud with the phone's voice

speech.recognize.summary: Speech to text after a tap, while the app is open

clipboard.read.summary: Paste from the clipboard after a tap

payments.request.summary: Web Payment Request to installed payment apps

net.local.summary: Find devices and services on the Wi-Fi or home network (mDNS) and open TCP or UDP sockets to them, while the app is open

wifi.scan.summary: Wi-Fi networks in range and the current Wi-Fi network; also needs Your location

wifi.control.summary: Open the Wi-Fi settings and suggest networks to join; each suggestion asks the user first

apps.launch.summary: Open another app installed on this phone, while the app is open

auth.session.summary: Sign in with a website in the browser (Custom Tab) and get the redirect back, while the app is open

background.summary: Run the manifest background module for up to 30 seconds when a declared trigger fires, even when the app is closed

foreground.summary: Keep the app's page running with a notification after the user leaves it (location, mediaPlayback, microphone, connectedDevice or dataSync; started while the app is open)

media.session.summary: Lock-screen, headset and Bluetooth media controls for audio the app keeps playing with foreground (type mediaPlayback)

push.summary: Push messages from the app's server through a UnifiedPush distributor such as ntfy (no Google services); a closed app gets them as a background run, a notification or on next open

accounts.own.summary: The app's own accounts in system Settings, with a sync that wakes it (background trigger sync)

device.id.summary: A device id for the app that other apps cannot see; the same app gets the same id

net.sockets.summary: TCP and UDP sockets to servers on the internet; also needs network.open

network.open.summary: fetch, WebSocket, EventSource, images and media from any HTTPS origin

network.user.summary: Servers the user adds on the dashboard, read with net.fetch (no CORS limits). net.fetch to manifest network origins needs no capability; declare this only for user-added servers

wasm.summary: WebAssembly (.wasm) files shipped in the app or hash-pinned dependencies

storage.large.summary: Larger app package (up to the free space on the phone) and binaries up to 200 MiB; asset packs not included

web.embed.summary: Third-party scripts and frames (payment forms, maps, video) from manifest embeds origins the user approved
